name: Rag Man
description: Entity summoned by Ith to bring someone to free him.

description_citations.text: "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mita learns that all the village children are children of the Rag Man and flees, becoming the first woman to be changed.
timeline.quote: From then on, Mita can travel everywhere see the world in dreams

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Inheritance , by S. D. Perry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Sima; their ship is hit by a storm and Jodah is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man, who leads him to the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: he falls overboard and is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Fall of the Conclave and Mairsil's death, it is revealed that Barl created Ith's replacement Rag Man and received his punishment.
timeline.quote: The new Rag Man turned out to be created by none other than Barl.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Barl's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah is traded to the Rag Man and taken to the Conclave of Mages, where he passes Mairsil's test.
timeline.quote: Jodah succeeded in the test that Mairsil , the ruler of the Conclave, had set for him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man
